column1: # Parity cases that stop on a typed refusal on the Rust arm although the Rust engine serves the member (or the case's setup step was refused). Edited by hand.
# One file per owner (test/rust-stop-pins/<owner>.tsv); every file is read, so an owner adds or removes only its own rows.
# Columns (tab separated): parity file, case name, member that refused, owner, due date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC), what Rust declines.
# A row lets the case stop on that member's typed refusal (GBRAIN_TEST_RUST_ARM=1). The run fails when the case stops on another member, when the
# due date has passed (the row goes red at 00:00 UTC on the day after the due date), or when the case no longer stops (remove the row).
